providers.operation: Build repeatable training batches while keeping the caller’s random streams continuous across passes.
providers.validity_bounds: Caller-owned source arrays, orders and persistent random streams. Preserve threshold multiplicities, sampled proposal order, partial batches, and source spatial adapters across passes.

providers.operation: Select high-scoring proposals and form padded image crops and coordinate grids for the source classifier.
providers.validity_bounds: Source score order, top-k proposal selection, empty-slot retention and padded coordinate frame. Crops must match the source classifier architecture.

providers.operation: Build the source recipe’s three evaluation groups using caller-supplied arrays and random streams.
providers.validity_bounds: Caller-owned source arrays, orders and persistent random streams. Keep the three source validation population roles distinct; factory iteration remains in process.

providers.operation: Convert the source detector’s output grid into scored cubic proposals using its fixed anchor sizes and spacing.
providers.validity_bounds: Source fixed anchor sizes, stride four, score threshold strictly greater than -3 and cubic proposal encoding.

providers.operation: Keep proposals whose source detector score is strictly greater than minus one.
providers.validity_bounds: Source score threshold strictly greater than -1. Scores are not interpreted as probabilities.

providers.operation: Check that image and coordinate tiles align, then apply the source image intensity scaling.
providers.validity_bounds: Matching paired tile grids and source (float32(image)-128)/128 intensity transform; caller-supplied image semantics.

providers.operation: Evaluate caller-supplied classifier crops and return both the combined score and each proposal’s score.
providers.validity_bounds: Source eval-mode classifier and crops in the expected normalized coordinate convention. Model scores are not a calibration or predictive-quality guarantee.

providers.operation: Evaluate ordered image tiles with a caller-supplied detector already in evaluation mode.
providers.validity_bounds: Source eval-mode detector and aligned image/coordinate tiles; serial ordered CPU batches. No substitute model architecture or non-eval state is qualified.

providers.operation: Pad an image to the detector spacing and build coordinates over the entire padded image before tiling.
providers.validity_bounds: Source stride four, max stride sixteen and global padded-volume coordinates. Tile geometry must satisfy the validated divisibility and margin checks.

providers.operation: Remove overlapping cubic proposals using the source recipe’s fixed overlap threshold.
providers.validity_bounds: Source cubic-box overlap convention and threshold .05, with retained score ordering.

providers.operation: Copy model weights to CPU memory and return serialized weights and an epoch number.
providers.validity_bounds: In-memory bytes containing only epoch and CPU-copied state_dict; no optimizer or RNG resume state. The caller controls storage. Concrete model required.

providers.operation: Evaluate the source classifier and combine loss and accuracy using the number of cases in each batch.
providers.validity_bounds: Source classifier model and nonempty batches. Sets eval mode; weights losses by case count. Uses strict score > .5; model and batch objects must satisfy source contracts.

providers.operation: Evaluate the source detector, average batch losses equally, and add classification counts.
providers.validity_bounds: Source detector model and nonempty batches. Sets eval mode, disables gradients, averages each batch equally and sums counts. training=False excludes ranked hard-negative selection.

providers.operation: Run consecutive source training epochs while keeping shared weights, optimizers, and random streams alive.
providers.validity_bounds: Qualified source networks and persistent factory classes, shared detector identity, matching optimizer ownership, explicit orders and random streams. Variant 3 epochs 49–51 and variant 4 epochs 159–161 are source-qualified. Arbitrary callbacks, replacement models/factories, other schedules and full competition training are not certified.

interfaces.name: prepare_epoch
interfaces.callback_contract: Caller-owned per-epoch ordering callback. Only the qualified callback behavior is covered; arbitrary callbacks are not certified.

providers.operation: Restore separate detector and classifier weights and set both models to evaluation mode.
providers.validity_bounds: Separate source detector and classifier networks on CPU, restored from caller checkpoint bytes and placed in eval mode. Checkpoint provenance is caller responsibility.

providers.operation: Restore shared detector and classifier weights and create fresh optimizers for a model warm restart.
providers.validity_bounds: CPU source network classes, shared detector identity, fresh SGD optimizers with source momentum and weight decay. Model warm restart only: optimizer and RNG state are not restored.

providers.operation: Prepare the source recipe’s five input groups using explicit coordinate conventions.
providers.validity_bounds: Explicit source training/validation population roles and voxel/world coordinate conventions; orientation and sentinel policies are not interchangeable. No file loading or inferred provenance.

providers.operation: Apply the source image segmentation, cleanup, resizing, and cropping recipe.
providers.validity_bounds: Source segmentation and cleanup with requested-spacing crop conventions. Effective resizing spacing may differ after shape rounding. This is a source preprocessing recipe, not a universal image-cleaning method.

providers.operation: Assign source detector targets to anchor boxes, using a separate caller-owned random stream.
providers.validity_bounds: Selected-target anchor assignment, not generic assignment of every surrounding box. Caller-owned Python random.Random; None target means a negative crop. Historical Python 2 random.sample equivalence is not claimed.

interfaces.name: rng
interfaces.runtime_contract: Caller-owned random.Random for anchor assignment; caller-owned numpy.random.RandomState for crop and augmentation. Execution advances the supplied stream; None and omitted values are rejected.

providers.operation: Apply the source classifier’s configured random flips, rotation, and axis swaps to a crop.
providers.validity_bounds: Source rotation changes the image but not the coordinate grid; disabled by default. Preserve configured flips and axis swaps; no claim of geometrically corrected augmentation.

interfaces.name: rng
interfaces.runtime_contract: Caller-owned random.Random for anchor assignment; caller-owned numpy.random.RandomState for crop and augmentation. Execution advances the supplied stream; None and omitted values are rejected.

providers.operation: Apply the source detector’s configured random transforms to a crop, target, boxes, and coordinates.
providers.validity_bounds: Source flip positions use size-coordinate. Finite positive-size targets and boxes; explicit caller RandomState advances in source order.

interfaces.name: rng
interfaces.runtime_contract: Caller-owned random.Random for anchor assignment; caller-owned numpy.random.RandomState for crop and augmentation. Execution advances the supplied stream; None and omitted values are rejected.

providers.operation: Crop around a proposal using the source classifier’s padding, scale, and jitter rules.
providers.validity_bounds: Retain clamped crop starts and padded-frame coordinates, Python 2 integer crop halves, source jitter and scale rules. Returned images are not yet normalized. Explicit caller RandomState required.

interfaces.name: rng
interfaces.runtime_contract: Caller-owned random.Random for anchor assignment; caller-owned numpy.random.RandomState for crop and augmentation. Execution advances the supplied stream; None and omitted values are rejected.

providers.operation: Crop an image and transform its detector targets using the source training rules.
providers.validity_bounds: Retain source random-crop and scale policies with explicit caller RandomState. Missing target requires unscaled random crop; crop size must be divisible by stride.

interfaces.name: rng
interfaces.runtime_contract: Caller-owned random.Random for anchor assignment; caller-owned numpy.random.RandomState for crop and augmentation. Execution advances the supplied stream; None and omitted values are rejected.

providers.operation: Initialize a source classifier from explicit detector weights.
providers.validity_bounds: Transfer caller detector weights into the source classifier and initialize a new case head using caller Torch RNG. Epoch-zero model-only checkpoint; not a trained classifier or prediction-quality claim.

providers.operation: Return up to the requested number of candidate indices in descending score order.
providers.validity_bounds:
Return up to k candidate indices ranked by descending finite score.

Candidates are unique int64 indices into a floating score vector on the
same device. Empty candidates and zero k yield empty indices. Uses native
torch.topk ordering, including its tie behavior; no stable or cross-device
tie ordering is promised. Selection is discrete, but gathering scores by
the returned indices preserves their ordinary autograd path. No label or
batch-size interpretation is built in; the caller determines candidates/k.

providers.operation: Compute a weighted logarithmic penalty for probabilities below a chosen threshold.
providers.validity_bounds:
Return -sum(float32(p<threshold)*weights*log(p+offset))/B/K.

Finite B,K float32/float64 probabilities lie in [0,1]; finite weights lie in [0,1]
and match shape, dtype and device. The strict mask has no gradient, while
probability and weight paths retain autograd. Averages over all entries,
including unselected entries. Inputs and control values remain unchanged.
Offset is explicit; p+offset>1 can yield a negative contribution, so callers
must select controls appropriate for their objective. No labels or domains
are inferred. Float32 mask and ordered divisions preserve source arithmetic.

providers.operation: Combine each row of probabilities with a caller-supplied baseline score using the complement of their product.
providers.validity_bounds:
Return 1-prod(1-p)*(1-sigmoid(b)) per row, preserving autograd.

Inputs are nonempty finite B,K floating probability tensors in [0,1] and
a finite one-element floating baseline logit on the same device/dtype.
The baseline is caller-owned; this operation creates no trainable state.
No clamping, detachment, normalization or hidden class/feature ordering.
Probabilistic interpretation requires caller-established assumptions about
the events; this algebra alone does not establish independence or calibration.

providers.operation: Return a centered view of a tensor along selected axes without copying its values.
providers.validity_bounds:
Return a tensor view cropped around each selected axis's integer center.

Each window starts at dimension//2-width//2 and contains exactly width
elements. This explicitly determines even/odd alignment. Unselected axes,
dtype, device and autograd are preserved. No padding, copying, reduction,
channel interpretation or normalization. Returned storage aliases the input.

providers.operation: Multiply, divide, then shift coordinate rows using explicit values for each axis.
providers.validity_bounds:
Return float64 coordinate rows multiplied, divided, then shifted per axis.

Computes (rows*numerator)/denominator-offset in that order, without
precomputing a scale ratio. Signed scales are allowed. All vectors must
match the row width; empty row sets are valid. Input is preserved and output
is newly allocated. No axis reordering, absolute value, geometric clipping,
orientation inference, unit assumptions, or annotation-sentinel policy.

providers.operation: Resize a three-dimensional array to a requested spacing and return the spacing actually achieved.
providers.validity_bounds:
Resample a finite 3D array; return array and effective axis spacing.

Shape is rounded from shape*spacing/requested_spacing using NumPy rounding.
Interpolation uses scipy.ndimage.zoom with nearest boundary extension,
default prefiltering and grid_mode=False. Output retains the input dtype;
integer interpolation therefore retains SciPy's integer rounding behavior.
Effective spacing is spacing*input_shape/output_shape and can differ from
requested spacing. Axis order and physical units are caller-defined; no
orientation, intensity normalization, segmentation or coordinate mapping.

providers.operation: Remove tile margins and reconstruct the padded volume in the required tile order.
providers.validity_bounds:
Remove margins and reconstruct finite T,Z,Y,X,... tiles as Z,Y,X,... .

Trailing payload axes are optional and opaque. Output is float32, retaining
the padded grid extent rather than trimming to the original volume shape.
Requires every tile in X-fastest order; no overlap averaging or missing-tile
imputation. Side and margin are input-grid units, divided by output stride.
Rejects nonfinite input or float32 overflow; leaves caller arrays unchanged.

providers.operation: Split a volume into overlapping cubic tiles, extending edge values where padding is needed.
providers.validity_bounds:
Split finite C,Z,Y,X arrays into ordered edge-padded cubic tiles and grid.

Returns T,C,Z,Y,X tiles and a three-integer grid, with X varying fastest.
Each tile has side_len+2*margin samples per spatial axis. Boundary values
are extended by edge padding. Retains input dtype; no intensity transform,
coordinate generation or model inference. Caller supplies spatial units.

providers.operation: Repeat each row by adding the configured counts for thresholds its selected value strictly exceeds.
providers.validity_bounds:
Repeat each row by the sum of multiplicities for strictly exceeded thresholds.

Thresholds are finite, strictly increasing caller-unit values, including
negative values when appropriate. Multiplicities are nonnegative integers.
Rows below or equal to the first threshold disappear; there is no implicit
base copy. Retains input row order and dtype, returning a fresh matrix.
Empty row populations are valid. No labels, units or sampling policy inferred.

providers.operation: Choose indices without replacement using scores, recomputing selection probabilities after every draw.
providers.validity_bounds:
Select indices without replacement, recomputing floored softmax each draw.

Each draw divides remaining scores by temperature, normalizes exponentials,
floors probabilities, then normalizes again. The floor applies before the
second normalization, not as a guaranteed final lower bound. If k covers
all candidates, return original order without consuming RNG state. Empty
vectors and k=0 are valid. Uses a local RandomState from a seed, or advances
the supplied RandomState; never uses NumPy's global RNG. No model fitting.

limitations: Automated Tier 3 review only; no Tier 1 human review or Tier 2 community-usage evidence claimed.
Ten generic operations support cross-domain reuse within explicit numerical contracts; source recipes retain their conventions.
Exact CPU library versions and provisioned in-process runtime only; no clean-install or historical-library reproduction claim.
Synthetic computational parity does not establish predictive quality, calibration, or domain validity.
Model/factory/callback objects require the qualified bindings; arbitrary replacements are not certified.
Publication rollback/corruption gates and production selection remain required.
